gifts.title: Your Year In Tides
gifts.about: A whole year of tides at your place, drawn as rings, like the rings of a tree: the year someone was born, the year you married, the year you moved to the coast, or a year still ahead.

gifts.title: Beach Wedding Welcome Sign
gifts.about: A welcome sign for a wedding by the water: the predicted tide at your town or beach on your wedding day, with the time of your ceremony marked on the curve.

gifts.title: 2026 Winter Solstice Print: The Light Returns
2027 Year of Daylight Print: Any City
gifts.about: Every day of 2027 in your city, drawn as light: a ring of 365 spokes, one for each day, with the hours the sun is up as a band of gold (or coral) around it. Made to order for any city in the world with a sunrise and a sunset every day of the year.

gifts.title: 2027 Sunrise and Sunset Calendar: Anchorage
gifts.about: A printable 2027 sunrise and sunset calendar for Anchorage, Alaska: every day of the year, a month to a page, with its sunrise, its sunset and how long the sun is up.

gifts.title: 2027 Sunrise and Sunset Calendar: Seattle
gifts.about: A printable 2027 sunrise and sunset calendar for Seattle, Washington: every day of the year, a month to a page, with its sunrise, its sunset and how long the sun is up.

2027 Night Sky Print: New York
gifts.about: The night sky of 2027 over New York, New York, on one sheet: every full and new moon, the year's five eclipses, the peaks of seven meteor showers, and when each of the five bright planets is up after dusk or before dawn.
